    prettyprint: bool=True, indent: str='') ->str:
    from . import gpx as mod_gpx
    if version not in ('1.0', '1.1'):
        raise mod_gpx.GPXException(f'Invalid version: {version}')
    
    # Handle the case where value might be a GPX object itself
